summary: Nu Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a notice of annual general meeting for August 6, 2026. The meeting will approve audited financial statements for FY2025, reelect nine director nominees including David Vélez Osorno and Anita Sands, and ratify the annual report. The record date is June 26, 2026. The board recommends voting FOR all resolutions. This is a routine AGM notice with no special-situation event.
